bench_setup = function() {
  set.seed(20261117)
  n = 200L
  w = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5)
  Z = matrix(rnorm(n * 2L), n, 2L, dimnames = list(NULL, c("x1", "x2")))
  t_event = exp(3 + 0.4 * w + as.numeric(Z %*% c(0.3, -0.2)) + 0.7 * log(rexp(n)))
  t_cens = rexp(n, 1 / 40)
  time = pmin(t_event, t_cens)
  dead = as.numeric(t_event <= t_cens)
  X = cbind(treatment = w, Z)
  row_weights = rexp(n)          # one Bayesian-bootstrap draw
  list(time = time, dead = dead, X = X, row_weights = row_weights)
}
stands_in_for: R/EDI/R/globals.R:378 (weighted_weibull_bootstrap_surrogate_fit, unclustered branch, as called per draw from R/EDI/R/inference_survival_weibull.R:89)
notes: Times one Bayesian-bootstrap draw's weighted Weibull fit at n = 200 (treatment + 2 covariates, ~30% censored), returning (beta_hat, se). Candidate calls the exported-but-internal survival::survreg.fit on the prebuilt matrix with the same transform (log time, extreme-value dist), default control and init = NULL that survreg() uses, so it runs the identical Newton-Raphson and should agree to rounding; checked against survival master's survreg.R/survreg.fit.R signature (x, y, weights, offset, init, controlvals, dist, scale, nstrat, strata, parms, assign). The cluster/robust branch and the warm-start (KK marginal) caller are not covered.
